name: Yue Ye de Gongzhu yu Yongzhe
source:
Yoru, a fresh graduate entering the workforce, has always admired a person called Luna.
They are childhood friends sharing the same upbringing and even having the same birthday.
However, they have walked completely different paths, and Yoru feels ashamed of herself.
And what's more...
Yoru has kept hidden feelings for Luna in her heart since she was a child.
After 10 years, now Yoru has finally decided to tell her.
She's going to muster up her courage and say those words to her "Princess".

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4202340/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
夜，一名刚进入职场的毕业生，一直很欣赏一个叫露娜的人。
他们是青梅竹马，有着相同的成长经历，甚至同一天的生日。
然而，他们却走上了完全不同的道路，夜为自己感到羞愧。
更重要的是…
夜对露娜从小就怀有隐藏的感情。
10年后，现在Yoru终于决定告诉她。
她要鼓起勇气，对她的“公主”说出这句话。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4202340/]Steam[/url]]
